copy.hero_sub: Serving Marietta and East Cobb Mon–Fri, 8AM–5PM. We show up when we say we will, locate the leak with non-invasive equipment, and give you a flat-rate price before any work starts.
copy.services_lead: We specialize in finding water where it shouldn't be — in slabs, walls, and supply lines — so you're not paying to tear up half your house guessing.

services.title: Slab Leak Detection
services.body: Electronic listening equipment pinpoints the break under your slab before one inch of concrete comes up.

services.title: Water Line Location
services.body: We trace pressurized supply lines in Marietta homes — copper, CPVC, PEX — without opening walls blind.

services.title: Pool & Spa Leak Test
services.body: Pressure-test fittings, returns, and skimmer lines to isolate the loss before you drain the pool.

services.title: Irrigation Leak Scan
services.body: Zone-by-zone scan of buried poly and PVC lines across East Cobb and Roswell properties.

services.title: Sewer & Drain Camera
services.body: Push a RIDGID SeeSnake camera through the line and get a recording — no interpretation fees tacked on.

what_we_dont_do: We don't quote a repair price over the phone before we've seen the leak.
We don't perform the repairs ourselves — you keep the contractor you already trust.
copy.guarantee: If we can't locate the leak during the scheduled visit, you don't pay the diagnostic fee.

reviews_list.author: A Marietta homeowner
reviews_list.text: They found a slab leak under my kitchen in under an hour. No guessing, no torn-up floors before they knew exactly where it was. Flat rate just like they said.

reviews_list.author: B. from East Cobb
reviews_list.text: Showed up on time, used their equipment, marked the spot. Done. My plumber said it was the most accurate location he'd ever been handed.

copy.footer_blurb: National Leak Detection works Marietta, Sandy Springs, East Cobb, Roswell, and Kennesaw — Monday through Friday, no weekend dispatch fees.
